facts.value: Check with staff.mobility@ul.ie to see if funding is available. Funding is allocated on a first come basis.
Complete the Staff Mobility agreement for Teaching or Training.
Submit your fully signed mobility agreement to staff.mobility@ul.ie.
Allow 10 working days for your contract to be issued.
Complete the final report which you will receive via email from a Europa.eu email address.
Your final grant payment will be made within 10 working days on receipt of all documentation.
Complete the Acknowledgement of Grant Receipt form and return the completed form to staff.mobility@ul.ie.

Eligible activities include a small, medium or large enterprise (including social enterprises), a public body at local, regional or national level, a research institute; a foundation; a school/institute/educational centre, a non-profit organisation, association or NGO, and a body providing career guidance, professional counselling, and information services.
